source_registry.point_in_time_variance: Two sweeps 5 minutes apart gave ACTIVE 69 then 67 (candidates 504193 then 502189). The delta is upstream availability (transient 502/429/432/507), NOT a code change. Live source counts are a RANGE, not a constant: ACTIVE 67-69 on 2026-08-24. Both snapshots kept.
source_registry.note: ADR-013 fetch fix (iter_chunked to EOF) raised candidates from 74895 to ~502-504k on the same 120 URLs. short_read is only evaluated for identity-encoded responses: aiohttp auto-decompresses, so Content-Length is the COMPRESSED size for 83 of 120 URLs and is not comparable to the decoded body length.
